presets.name: Drowned Tines
presets.desc: Tine piano with highs and lows cut, slow tape wobble and a dark halo. Two-chord beds.

presets.name: Half-Speed Keys
presets.desc: Keys printed to tape at 0.85x: slower wobble, darker top. Sits with slowed tracks.

presets.name: Hushed Felt Grand
presets.desc: Soft, close felt piano with the top rolled off. Ballads and slow trap-soul.

presets.name: Syrup Tine
presets.desc: Warm, barky tine piano with chorus and light drive. Neo-soul comping.

presets.name: Dusk Poly Chords
presets.desc: Saw plus pulse plus sub with thick chorus. Chord stabs or held beds.

presets.name: Pump Saw Stab
presets.desc: Wide supersaw stab with a snappy filter, ducking to the beat. House chords.

presets.name: Chorus Jangle Clean
presets.desc: Clean single-coil style guitar through soft chorus and a plate. Bedroom-pop jangle.

presets.name: Five-Take Steel Acoustic
presets.desc: Picked steel-string guitar spread wide, open strings ringing. Verse to big chorus.

presets.name: Porch Nylon
presets.desc: Warm nylon pluck with a woody body. Sad-trap loops and Latin ostinatos.

presets.name: Spring Surf Strum
presets.desc: Bright, slightly driven guitar for fast surf punk and bedroom indie.

presets.name: Night Celesta
presets.desc: Glassy celesta, bright but small. Sparse high arpeggios above the vocal.

presets.name: Boogie Keytar
presets.desc: Saw-plus-pulse lead with a snappy filter. Boogie answer phrases.

presets.name: Bubble Reed Call
presets.desc: Breathy sax-like call soaked in ping-pong echo.

presets.name: Velvet Swell Strings
presets.desc: Ensemble saw strings with a slow swell, delayed vibrato and a soft top.

presets.name: Wonky Analog Poly
presets.desc: Slightly out-of-tune, heavily chorused brassy poly that ducks to the beat.

presets.name: Angel Stretch Cloud
presets.desc: Stretched, floating 'ooh-ah' cloud. In cloud rap it is the lead instrument.

presets.name: Voice-Memo Chop
presets.desc: Short pitched 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for house hooks.

presets.name: Long Glide 808
presets.desc: Clean, long sine 808 with a short pitch thump and soft drive.

presets.name: Disco Pulse Bass
presets.desc: Busy plucky bass with a short filter snap. Disco, boogie and house.

presets.name: Phone 808
presets.desc: Saturated, slightly crushed 808 that reads on small speakers. Plugg and lo-fi.

presets.name: Dotted Echo Arp
presets.desc: Clean guitar arp multiplied by a dotted-eighth echo into a cascade.

presets.name: Night Pluck Arp
presets.desc: Hollow square pluck for 1/16 arpeggios in melodic house.

presets.name: Round Walking Sub
presets.desc: Round sine-plus-harmonic sub that follows the roots. Afrobeats, cumbia, bedroom pop.

presets.name: Wood Bass Pluck
presets.desc: Woody plucked low string: a thump, then a soft decay. Upright or fingered bass.

presets.name: Cloud FM Bell
presets.desc: FM bell at a 3.5 ratio with light digital grain. Cloud-rap motifs.

presets.name: Bakelite Upright
presets.desc: A piano heard through an old radio: narrow band, mono, wow.

presets.name: Lounge Drawbar Organ
presets.desc: Soft soul drawbar organ with vibrato and gentle drive. Pumping stabs.

presets.name: Wobble Reed Keys
presets.desc: Reed piano with bite, tape wow and a dull top. Bedroom-pop and soft-rock chords.

presets.name: Brass Sigh Lead
presets.desc: Soft trumpet-like brass with a slow swell and delayed vibrato. Counter-melodies.

presets.name: Fat Mono Line
presets.desc: Fat two-saw mono line with resonant bite. Counter-melodies and bass doubles.

presets.name: Formant Night Pad
presets.desc: Breathy pad whose vowels morph over time. Ethereal beds.

presets.name: Ghost Swarm Bed
presets.desc: Dark drifting additive bed with airy noise. Two-chord drones.

presets.name: Shoegaze Haze Wall
presets.desc: Driven, detuned saw wall standing in for fuzzed guitars, long dark tails.

presets.name: Frozen Halo
presets.desc: Wordless choir wash that hangs in place between vocal phrases.

presets.name: L/C/R Ooh Choir
presets.desc: Stacked soft 'ooh' choir, triple-tracked wide. Intros and hooks.

presets.name: Reverse Ghost Chop
presets.desc: Reversed vocal swells for transitions and circular motifs.

presets.name: Garage Reese Floor
presets.desc: Detuned saw reese over a sine with a slow warble. Garage drops.

presets.name: Tropic Mallet
presets.desc: Soft-mallet marimba for tropical ostinatos and answer phrases.

presets.name: Cassette Hiss Bed
presets.desc: Pitched tape hiss and breath that glues bedroom tracks together.

presets.name: Feedback Drone
presets.desc: Beating tuned drone in the style of amp feedback. Swells under a section turn.

presets.name: Warehouse Stab Piano
presets.desc: Bright, hard-hammered piano for 90s house chord stabs.

presets.name: Club Organ Stab
presets.desc: Hollow, punchy organ for house bass-lines and chord stabs.

presets.name: Glassline Poly
presets.desc: Modern analog poly pluck with a glassy pulse edge.

presets.name: Twin Filter Scream
presets.desc: Screaming high-pass plus low-pass lead with resonant bite.

presets.name: Ladder Mono Bass
presets.desc: Three-oscillator ladder bass with a punchy filter snap.

presets.name: Ladder Lead
presets.desc: Fat ladder-filter solo lead with delayed vibrato.

presets.name: Brass Memory Poly
presets.desc: Big analog poly brass with a swelling filter.

presets.name: Prepared Bolt Piano
presets.desc: Piano with bolts and paper on the strings: metal partials and a buzz.

presets.name: Toy Box Piano
presets.desc: Tiny struck rods, a little out of tune. Nursery and lo-fi motifs.

presets.name: Saloon Tack Piano
presets.desc: Detuned strings and tacks on the hammers. Saloon and ragtime colour.

presets.name: Leaning Upright
presets.desc: An old upright nobody tunes, recorded to tape. Warm and wonky.

presets.name: Stage Electric Grand
presets.desc: Thin, bright stage piano with pickup shimmer. 80s ballads.

presets.name: Sticky Reed Keys
presets.desc: Short plucked reeds with a sticky attack. 60s pop keys.

presets.name: Funk Pick Clav
presets.desc: Bright plucked-string keys for tight funk rhythm parts.

presets.name: Tape Strip Strings
presets.desc: Strings on 8-second tape strips: wobble, hiss, and they run out.

presets.name: Tape Strip Flute
presets.desc: Breathy flute on a worn tape strip. Psych intros.

presets.name: Optical Disc Organ
presets.desc: Home organ read off a scratched optical disc. Crackle and wow.

presets.name: Digital Glass EP
presets.desc: Glassy digital FM electric piano with a bright tine ping. 80s ballads.

presets.name: Velvet Tines
presets.desc: Clean, round electric piano with a gentle chorus. Neo-soul voicings.

presets.name: Submerged Felt
presets.desc: Felt piano heard through a wall: muffled hammers, warm wobble, long tail.

presets.name: Moonlit Upright
presets.desc: Soft upright with a little detune between strings. Honest and close.

presets.name: Perreo Keys
presets.desc: Bright, barky stab keys that sit on a dembow groove. Pump locked to the beat.

presets.name: Submerged Choir
presets.desc: Ghost choir under water. Hold one chord and let it breathe.

presets.name: Midnight Wash
presets.desc: Wide detuned wash, low-passed until it is almost a memory.

presets.name: Supersaw Bloom
presets.desc: Nine-voice supersaw chords that duck to the beat. Instant drop.

presets.name: Neon Haze
presets.desc: Moody saw-and-pulse atmosphere for perreo intros and bridges.

presets.name: Cold Glass
presets.desc: Glassy additive shimmer with slow beating partials.

presets.name: Static Bloom
presets.desc: Pitched noise blooming into a tone. Texture under anything.

presets.name: Future Pluck
presets.desc: Detuned saw pluck with a snappy filter, pumping on the quarter note.

presets.name: Dembow Nylon
presets.desc: Nylon-string pluck with a woody body. Arpeggios and tresillo riffs.

presets.name: Night Marimba
presets.desc: Soft-mallet marimba with a night-time reverb. Tropical melodies.

presets.name: Dusty Kalimba
presets.desc: Thumb piano through a dusty tape deck.

presets.name: Vox Chop Pluck
presets.desc: Short synthetic 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for vocal-chop hooks.

presets.name: Waterlogged Keen
presets.desc: High, soft sine-ish pluck through water. Dotted-eighth echoes for floating hooks.

presets.name: Glint Harp
presets.desc: Bright plucked harp, wide reverb, sparkling echoes.

presets.name: Hyper Saw Lead
presets.desc: Detuned saw lead for drop melodies. Grit and pump already dialled in.

presets.name: Velvet Square
presets.desc: Rounded square lead, soft and vocal. Hooks over a dembow.

presets.name: Hollow Flute
presets.desc: Breathy synthetic flute with delayed vibrato.

presets.name: Siren Vox Lead
presets.desc: Wordless synthetic voice with a singer's vibrato.

presets.name: Dirty Brass Lead
presets.desc: Low, fuzzy synth brass: dirty, nothing bright. Heavy reggaeton riffs.

presets.name: Crystal FM Bell
presets.desc: Two-operator FM bell, glassy attack and a long shimmering tail.

presets.name: Music Box Memory
presets.desc: Tiny music box with a warped tape memory.

presets.name: Celeste Mist
presets.desc: Celeste under water. Pairs with low-passed keys.

presets.name: Gamelan Glass
presets.desc: Inharmonic metal bars that beat against each other.

presets.name: Ah Chop Stack
presets.desc: Stacked 'ah' chops for call-and-response hooks.

presets.name: Breath Vox
presets.desc: A pitched whisper. Doubles a topline without getting in the way.

presets.name: Formant Swirl
presets.desc: Vowels morphing a-o-e-u while you hold the note.

presets.name: Grit 808
presets.desc: Saturated 808 that reads on phone speakers.

presets.name: Punch 808
presets.desc: Short, punchy 808 for bouncing dembow bass lines.

presets.name: Reese Shadow
presets.desc: Detuned saw reese with a sine underneath. Dark and moving.

presets.name: Degraded Floor Bass
presets.desc: Saw plus sine bass crushed to a 4.4 kHz sample rate. Dark, grainy floor.

presets.name: Round Sub
presets.desc: Pure sustained sub. Sits under keys without clouding them.

presets.name: Dembow Bass
presets.desc: Round plucky bass for tight reggaeton lines.

presets.name: Ouroboros Bass
presets.desc: A Model D bass that swallows its own tail: the output fed back into the mixer overdrives a nonlinear ladder (D'Angelo-Valimaki model, 4x) and breathes with the filter contour. Three layers of drive, three thermal round robins, one key per sample.

presets.name: Seventy-One Throats
presets.desc: A divide-down vox ensemble breathing through a throat per key: two ranks from one top-octave divider, each on its own vibrato, through the vox formant EQ, three resonators and a static nonlinear ladder. Every beat and vibrato fits the loop exactly.

presets.name: Resonance Wraith
presets.desc: A ladder pushed just past oscillation and tracked to the key: the filter itself sings, a pure, slightly unstable sine that sags flat under its own amplitude, breathing on white noise; blown harder, more breath escapes around it. Three emphasis depths, three thermal takes.

presets.name: Resonance Wraith Bowl
presets.desc: The same singing ladder struck like a glass: a noise burst rings it, then the emphasis sinks through the threshold, so the tone dies naturally while its pitch climbs back toward the note. Three strike strengths, three different bursts. (A self-oscillating ring is near-pure at any strike: layers set level, ring length and pitch climb.)

presets.name: Orbiting Tines
presets.desc: A tine piano modelled from the strike up: a neoprene hammer tip hits a clamped steel tine, its bell clang melts into a near-sine bloom, and a magnetic pickup reads the tip's path, so harder playing barks. Five hammer speeds, three takes per key, tip hardness stepping up the keyboard, and long mid and bass tails. Dry and mono: add chorus or tremolo to taste.

presets.name: Glasgow Forks
presets.desc: Felt hammers on steel tuning forks over a small wooden box: pure, cold tones that never drift, and an octave ghost from the fork's stem that can outsing the note on hard strikes and dies twice as fast. Three hammer speeds, two takes per key, A2 to A7. Dry and mono.

presets.name: Harbor Lights Brass
presets.desc: Two lines per note, one drifting a few cents above the other, through resonant filters that never scream, with a pure sine slipped in after them. Each note swells brighter and settles; soft playing stays dark, hard playing opens up and slides up into pitch. Three strengths, three takes whose pulse widths drift in different phases, printed chorus.

presets.name: Willow Gate Bells
presets.desc: The west-coast bong: two triangle cores bending each other's shape, struck open by a light pulse through a vactrol lowpass gate that snaps open and sighs shut, so every note opens bright and wooden-metallic and closes into a warm hum. Soft playing barely lights the gate and stays dark. Three strengths, three takes. As the gate closes it drags the low notes a few cents flat, as the real circuit does.

presets.name: Three-Track Frame
presets.desc: A keyboard of tape strips, the head on the choir track: four voices singing 'oo'. Every key plays its own 8-second strip with its own tuning, level, wear and hiss, recorded from this bank's own voices; hold a note past eight seconds and the strip runs out. Two takes per key differ only in the pinch roller and the start-up scoop.

presets.name: Three-Track Frame (Forks)
presets.desc: A keyboard of tape strips, the head on the forks track. Every key plays its own 8-second strip with its own tuning, level, wear and hiss, recorded from this bank's own voices; hold a note past eight seconds and the strip runs out. Two takes per key differ only in the pinch roller and the start-up scoop.

presets.name: Three-Track Frame (Forks + Choir)
presets.desc: A keyboard of tape strips, the head parked between the forks and the choir, both worlds bleeding together a little dull. Every key plays its own 8-second strip with its own tuning, level, wear and hiss, recorded from this bank's own voices; hold a note past eight seconds and the strip runs out. Two takes per key differ only in the pinch roller and the start-up scoop.

presets.name: Three-Track Frame (Choir + Flute)
presets.desc: A keyboard of tape strips, the head parked between the choir and the flute. Every key plays its own 8-second strip with its own tuning, level, wear and hiss, recorded from this bank's own voices; hold a note past eight seconds and the strip runs out. Two takes per key differ only in the pinch roller and the start-up scoop.

presets.name: Three-Track Frame (Flute)
presets.desc: A keyboard of tape strips, the head on the flute track. Every key plays its own 8-second strip with its own tuning, level, wear and hiss, recorded from this bank's own voices; hold a note past eight seconds and the strip runs out. Two takes per key differ only in the pinch roller and the start-up scoop.

presets.name: Hollow Log Drum
presets.desc: A pitched log drum for amapiano basslines: every hit thumps in a few semitones sharp and drops onto the note within about 80 ms, with a hollow, woody honk in the mids that fades into a round low tone, so the line talks on phone speakers and still moves the floor. Harder hits honk more; bend it for slides between notes.

presets.name: Offbeat Bubble Organ
presets.desc: Drawbar organ with fast third-harmonic percussion on every key: it pops on the attack and fades within about half a second, tonewheel-steady and spread a little wide. Chop it short on the off-beats, left hand and right hand trading, and it bubbles under a one-drop; hold it for dub chords and it never wavers.

presets.name: Choked Skank Guitar
presets.desc: Clean electric guitar choked the moment it speaks: a bright scratch, a short ring, then gone. Stack three-note voicings on beats 2 and 4 for a one-drop, or on every off-beat for dancehall, and let the dotted echo answer.

presets.name: Low Sun Steel Pan
presets.desc: A tenor steel pan voiced from measured partials: octave and twelfth sit slightly flat, the way a real pan note rings, with a rubber-tip tick on the strike. Soft hits are round, hard hits shimmer. Sweet on top, a little sad underneath.

presets.name: Palm Wine Pluck
presets.desc: Bright single-coil guitar picked near the bridge, clean and dry enough to sit in the gaps. Made for looping highlife lines in thirds and sixths that dance around the vocal; every pluck has the same warm twang up the neck.

presets.name: Overcast Chorus Bass
presets.desc: Picked electric bass played high up the neck through a bucket-brigade chorus and a small, pushed amp. The lows stay centred and solid while the clank swims wide. It carries the melody when the guitars go cold.

presets.name: Square Bounce Bass
presets.desc: Hollow square wave and a square sub an octave down, snapped open by a quick ladder sweep, then held round and steady. Bouncy triplet lines at club tempo, or stiff electro riffs locked to the kick.

presets.name: Low End Chop
presets.desc: Tine comping printed through a 25 kHz sampler with a steep, resonance-free filter. Sweep TONE from 250 Hz for the bassline up to the full chop.

presets.name: Rainy Tine Keys
presets.desc: Soft tine piano sampled at 32 kHz with a slow 0.5 Hz wobble. Ninths and sus chords at 56-60% swing.

presets.name: Basement Drop Piano
presets.desc: Piano played an octave up and dropped 12 semitones by resampling: slow hammers, dark top, long tails. Sparse minor seconds and tritones.

presets.name: Glass Ballad Tines
presets.desc: Digital FM electric piano: 1:1 body with a 14:1 tinkle on the attack. Soft playing stays round, hard playing turns clangy.

presets.name: Bark Stage Tines
presets.desc: Stage tine piano with a low-mid bump and amp drive: round when soft, barking when you dig in.

presets.name: Reed Bite Keys
presets.desc: Steel-reed electric piano that breaks into bite on hard hits. Bedroom R&B chords at the writing desk.

presets.name: Clank House Piano
presets.desc: Bright hard-hammer piano band-limited to 32 kHz and stretched 3 semitones per zone, on purpose. Offbeat sevenths and minor-ninth stabs.

presets.name: Barrio Sheen Pluck
presets.desc: Brittle saw-and-pulse digital pluck with a fast filter snap. Minor i-VI-III-VII as 16th broken chords at 90-98 BPM.

presets.name: Steel Lotus
presets.desc: Hand-struck steel tone fields tuned 1:2:3 with a faint fifth halo. Built for D minor.

presets.name: Sierra Lead Runs
presets.desc: Small nylon six-string tuned a fourth above guitar, picked close to the bridge. Triplet runs in harmonic minor over half-time hats.

presets.name: Highland Ten-String
presets.desc: Bright paired-course plucks in the small Andean ten-string's range, one zone per semitone. Fast 16th strums on the 'and'.

presets.name: Optical Lullaby Guitar
presets.desc: Nylon guitar read off an optical disc: 150 Hz to 5 kHz, wow and flutter, hard on and off. Slow lullaby arpeggios.

presets.name: Seven Sun Saw
presets.desc: Seven free-running saws with a measured centre-heavy detune, printed mono with a thin bottom. Wide only through the FX.

presets.name: Anthem Brass Stab
presets.desc: Fat workstation-style synth brass: quick filter bite, octave-down weight, a forward 1 kHz horn band. Anthem stabs.

presets.name: Smoked Horn Section
presets.desc: Low synth horn section printed through a dark clip: dirty, nothing bright. Off-beat minor stabs over a dembow.

presets.name: Far Apart Duo
presets.desc: A filtered saw on the left and a thin pulse on the right, a few cents apart. Two elements, far apart.

presets.name: Rain Neon Brass
presets.desc: Two-layer analog brass that swells open under your touch and falls off the ribbon. Rain-soaked city chords.

presets.name: Kaleido Sweep Poly
presets.desc: One stable oscillator per voice, a darkened saw printed dry so a phaser and chorus can swirl it. Psych-pop beds.

presets.name: Hillside Lament
presets.desc: Cheap, grainy phone-ROM strings in a big hall. Minor chords held for bars, an empty bar before the drop.

presets.name: Coastline Chorus Pad
presets.desc: Steady one-oscillator pad with a sub an octave down and a breath of noise, printed dry for a slow stereo chorus.

presets.name: Mono Memory Pad
presets.desc: A wide unison pad collapsed to mono and glued on tape. Narrow, close and instantly nostalgic.

presets.name: First Light Bellpad
presets.desc: A struck glassy attack over a warm sustained body, bell partials fading into the pad. Late-80s digital dawn.

presets.name: Cruise Whistle Lead
presets.desc: High, near-sine whine with a touch of second harmonic that brightens when you dig in. Mod wheel for vibrato. West-coast leads.

presets.name: Tinnitus Siren
presets.desc: Piercing pure tone doubled 7 cents sharp so it beats like ringing ears. Play it high and keep it quiet.

presets.name: Broken Platter Cumbia
presets.desc: Three wet-tuned reeds played off a turntable running slow: deeper, darker and watery. Sonidero melodies.

presets.name: Altiplano Breath
presets.desc: Dark, breathy notched-flute tone with a chiff on every note and a live singer's vibrato. Andean minor phrases.

presets.name: Wet Rim Seraph
presets.desc: Rubbed glass rims: a near-pure tone that swells in under a faint 5 Hz shimmer. Slow legato, two notes at most.

presets.name: Ribbon Wraith
presets.desc: A soft, peak-limited sine that glides on a 12-semitone bend and sings with the mod wheel. Haunted film lines.

presets.name: Hillside Lament Horn
presets.desc: Mournful phone-ROM horn with a late vibrato. Answers the strings in two or three notes.

presets.name: Molasses Glide Sub
presets.desc: Long-decay kick played as a bassline: a quick strike chirp, a small sigh, then a sustained sine with bite.

presets.name: Paredao Pressure
presets.desc: Hard-clipped 808 with a two-octave dive and a pushed 110 Hz bump for car walls and phone speakers.

presets.name: Lowland Growl Bass
presets.desc: Three-oscillator ladder bass overdriven back into itself: a fast filter snap, then a fat growl.

presets.name: Warehouse Click Organ
presets.desc: Hollow organ bass with a clicky third harmonic that dies away fast. Octave-jumping off-beat house lines.

presets.name: Wet Wire Squelch
presets.desc: Bare saw with a fixed decay into a live resonant ladder whose envelope snaps shut. Ride the cutoff.

presets.name: Haunted Music Box
presets.desc: Hollow FM music-box bell: odd partials, an octave sparkle and a dark top. Minor-key trap motifs over a choir bed.

presets.name: Iron Tonk Bell
presets.desc: Two clanging pulse tones about a flat fifth apart through a band-pass, with a fast two-stage decay. Push GRIT for drift-phonk cowbell leads.

presets.name: Pixel Bell FM
presets.desc: Bright 1:1 FM bell-pluck with a glassy high tine that settles to a soft held tone. Plugg melodies with ping-pong echo.

presets.name: Eight Hertz Bronze
presets.desc: Bronze bars struck in tuned pairs that beat against each other, about 8 Hz in the middle register. Shimmering interlocking figures.

presets.name: Helium Soul Chop
presets.desc: Small bright soul-singer stack with thin lows, a lifted top and an 11 kHz ceiling. Sped-up soul hooks.

presets.name: Stamp and Stutter
presets.desc: Dry, phone-band shouted syllable. Retrigger it in 16ths with a little GRIT for funk stamps and stutters.

presets.name: Eight-Second Seraphs
presets.desc: Eight-voice 'aah' on worn tape strips: soft start, wow, hiss, and every note runs out at eight seconds.

presets.name: Halo Smear Choir
presets.desc: Breathy stacked 'ah' choir pitched down four semitones on tape with a grainy stretch flutter. Angelic cloud-rap beds.

presets.name: Hiccup Honeycomb
presets.desc: Tiny vowel-gliding syllable, tape-glued and short. Play it like a drum for 2-step vocal hiccups.

presets.name: Ladder Poly
presets.desc: Three detuned saws per note pushed into a tanh-per-stage transistor ladder with a snappy filter envelope. Warm poly chords that sound like they have a pulse.

presets.name: Ladder Drone Pad
presets.desc: Detuned saws and a sub through a resonant ladder whose cutoff wanders like a tide, with LFO 2 breathing on the voice filter. Basement drones and dark beds.

presets.name: Ladder Ping Bell
presets.desc: No oscillator: a noise impulse pings a ladder filter on the edge of self-oscillation, each zone's ring pitch measured and corrected. Round, slightly drunk electronic bells.

presets.name: Singing Bowl Field
presets.desc: Bronze bowl modes in close doublets, rubbed at the rim instead of struck, so the beating rolls slowly across the stereo field. Dusk pads and held drones.

presets.name: Bowed Metal
presets.desc: A steel bar under a rough bow: the note blooms slowly through its inharmonic modes and refuses to die. Dark shipyard beds and long cinematic holds.

presets.name: Bowed Bar
presets.desc: Marimba bar modes over a tuned tube, bowed instead of struck: a soft wooden swell under a temple roof. Slow melodies and gentle pads.

presets.name: Rod Ring Waterbowl
presets.desc: Bowed clamped rods over a low bowl resonance, with sloshing water bending the pitch and sweeping a notch. The eerie haunted-house ring, made playable.

presets.name: Paper Saints Ensemble
presets.desc: Phase-locked organ footages through a two-band vowel and a triple-BBD ensemble: a hollow, slightly wrong paper choir. New-wave chords at dawn.

presets.name: Faded Velour Strings
presets.desc: Divide-down 8' and 16' string tone split into violin and cello voicing, a swimming triple-BBD ensemble and worn tape. Roller-disco pads and slow string beds.

presets.name: Strip Choir
presets.desc: Six singers, three low and three high, each with their own pitch and formant scatter, printed to eight-second tape strips. Hold too long and the strip runs out.

presets.name: Cave Chant
presets.desc: Four low voices humming 'o' in a cave while an overtone whistle glides between harmonics 6 and 12 once per loop. Drones, intros and beatless epics.

presets.name: Varispeed Saint Chop
presets.desc: A soul vowel sped up on a cassette deck so the formants rise with the pitch, like a small saint singing from a phone speaker. Short chop melodies.

presets.name: Dust Harmonium
presets.desc: Pump-organ free reeds with a slightly sharp octave rank, the bellows breathing under every chord, a little out of air. Slow hymn chords and drones.

presets.name: Undertone Lead
presets.desc: A saw with phase-locked undertones at a third and a fifth of its frequency, through a ladder filter. A lead that drags a humming shadow under every note.

presets.name: Rising Drop Pluck
presets.desc: Each note is a tuned bubble that chirps slightly upward as it rings, with a tiny splash on top. Stone-basin plucks for short melodies and arps with rests.

presets.name: Sigh Circuit 808
presets.desc: A circuit-modelled bridged-T kick held as a bass: a fast pitch jump, then a slow sigh downward like a tired breath in a parked car. Long half-time 808 lines.

presets.name: Eight-Second Ivory
presets.desc: A felt piano recorded onto eight-second tape strips in 1962, one strip per key, played back from a cabinet of spools: every note is its own little recording, and a note held too long simply runs out.

presets.name: Paper-Mute Upright
presets.desc: An upright in a dim flat with paper woven through its strings, so every note buzzes like a secret in the walls and dies a little sooner than it should.

presets.name: Lullaby Underwater
presets.desc: A celesta lullaby recorded an octave up and played back at half speed, so it lands in tune but slow and blurred, like a cassette left on a sunny windowsill and heard through bath water.

presets.name: Harp-Frame Grand
presets.desc: Hammered strings, no soundboard, a piezo on the harp: bright bite, short bass strings, nothing ringing but the strings. Sparse chords and root-plus-ninth dyads with rests between them.

presets.name: Tangent Whisper Keys
presets.desc: A tiny, almost silent keyboard in a candlelit study where the brass tangent stays on the string; play harder for a brighter twang, and push the mod wheel to make the note tremble like a confession.

presets.name: Lantern Celeste
presets.desc: Steel plates over tuned wooden boxes with a soft hammer thunk; the short release is the damper, the sustain pedal lets it ring. A lullaby with a secret.

presets.name: Tin Rod Lullaby
presets.desc: Clamped metal rods with a key thunk and a small wooden box, slightly out of tune. A toy piano left in the attic, played softly for someone asleep.

presets.name: Fork Piano
presets.desc: Tuning forks struck by felt hammers over a tuned stem resonance: pure, cold and ringing for ever. Physics-lab keys for slow, open voicings.

presets.name: Rotor Vibes Nocturne
presets.desc: Vibraphone bars over tuned tubes with the motor still spinning, so every chord pulses together from the onset. A smoky diner after closing.

presets.name: Thumbtack Parlour
presets.desc: An old parlour upright with a brass tack pushed into every hammer, in the back room of a seaside bar: soft notes stay wooden, hard ones jangle.

presets.name: Wired Harpsichord
presets.desc: A 1960s amplified harpsichord with pickups instead of a soundboard, quills plucking through a little chorus amp in a church basement. Like the real thing, its tone stays the same at every velocity.

presets.name: Folding Field Harmonium
presets.desc: A folding field harmonium opened in a tent while it rains: the reeds speak a moment late, a celeste rank beats slowly against them, and the bellows breathe once a bar.

presets.name: Transistor Lounge Piano
presets.desc: A 1968 transistor piano in a hotel lounge: one hollow, square-ish oscillator per key, switched on with a soft click, its upper harmonics fading first so every note mellows as it rings out. Play harder for a brighter edge.

presets.name: Glass Armonica Keys
presets.desc: Wet fingertips on a spinning stack of glass bowls in a candlelit parlour: each note swells in slowly and hangs in the air, and the mod wheel adds a trembling vibrato.

presets.name: Hollow Hour Lead
presets.desc: Clean near-triangle lead with a soft tick and a slow chorus swirl. Each note settles after it speaks; leave rests for the dotted echo.

presets.name: Two-Card Drift Poly
presets.desc: Two oscillators per note that never quite agree: each note a few cents off, a shade brighter or darker. Warm, unsteady chords.

presets.name: Corridor Glow Pad
presets.desc: Odd harmonics only: a hollow, clarinet-like glow that swells in, each overtone breathing at its own pace. A quiet bed for long notes.

presets.name: Three Wire Mono
presets.desc: Two saws and a sine an octave down, driven into a resonant low-pass that bites, then sings. One-note solo lines; vibrato on the wheel.

presets.name: Machine Hymn Vox
presets.desc: Buzzing oscillators sung through a throat that opens from 'oo' to 'oh'. No breath, no vibrato, only fast tape flutter. A cold hymn pad.

presets.name: Ivory Circuit Piano
presets.desc: A 70s synth piano: saw and pulse struck through a filter that snaps bright, then rings out. Play soft for felt. Chords and arps.

presets.name: Lantern Ensemble Strings
presets.desc: String machine: a bright saw per key, every key in perfect tune, thin at the bottom, a fast shimmer and one shared wobble. Held chords.

presets.name: Hustle DCO Bass
presets.desc: Saw and pulse locked on one note over a sine an octave down, plucked by a quick filter. Round, bouncy, dead-centre lines; long notes fade.

presets.name: Floorboard Pedal Bass
presets.desc: Two saws a breath apart over a sine, distorted through a resonant filter that blooms on each note and settles low. Deep held pedal notes.

presets.name: Stone Throat Chant
presets.desc: Five low voices hum 'oo' while a thin whistle of overtones rises inside the vowel and falls back about every nine seconds. Long drones.

presets.name: Keyhole Wind
presets.desc: Wind through a keyhole: each note starts dark and opens into a thin whistle on the pitch you play, gusting once a bar. Air above chords.

presets.name: Low Tide FM Pad
presets.desc: Hollow FM tone struck soft and left to ring through a low sample rate and old tape; the chord wobbles as one and ebbs like a tide.

presets.name: Baile Cowbell
presets.desc: Crushed two-tone metal bell played as a melody: bright on the strike, gone in a second, a little different every hit. Minor funk riffs.

presets.name: Ember Talk Lead
presets.desc: A nasal voice that opens 'ah' into 'eh' on every note, clipped through hot tape, dead centre. A talking dembow hook; the wah moves in eighths.

presets.name: Chrome Dembow Stab
presets.desc: Seven bright saws with a centre-heavy 18 cent spread, wide open: every hit flares for about a tenth of a second, then settles to a steady body. Stab it on the dembow and let PUMP duck it under the kick. Built to sit where the chord synth of a modern neoperreo drop sits.

presets.name: Callejon Twin Saw
presets.desc: Three saws close together through a gentle low-pass and a slow bucket-brigade chorus, a little driven: the thinner, chunkier chord of 2000s workstation reggaeton. Short stabs stay tight; held chords shimmer slowly.

presets.name: Smoke Hoover Chords
presets.desc: A dark rave chord: pulse-width saws against a detuned saw, each note scooping up into pitch from below (harder hits scoop further), through a fast swirling chorus. Hold it for menace under a verse, stab it for the old-school hoover hit.

presets.name: Hammer Rave Stab
presets.desc: Saw and pulse stack, wide and driven, with a hard filter snap that closes in 90 ms: the hard-trance hit. Strike it on the dembow off-beats; harder hits snap brighter.

presets.name: Gate Room Supersaw
presets.desc: A wide trance supersaw that speaks in 6 ms and lets go in 70 ms, so it gates cleanly: play the chord in 16ths for the trance gate, hold it for a bright Y2K pad.

presets.name: Airlock Pluck Chords
presets.desc: Five saws through a filter that bursts open and falls in about a tenth of a second, with a breath of air on top: airy trance pluck chords for the 16th-note offbeats.

presets.name: Glass Halo Bells
presets.desc: Glassy FM bell chords with a bright metallic strike that melts into a soft, slightly beating tone: the shiny internet-pop chord for intros and breakdowns.

presets.name: Velvet Witch Pad
presets.desc: Three saws through a warm, slowly wandering ladder filter on a wobbly tape: a dark, smoky pad for the moody side of perreo. Swells in over a third of a second.

presets.name: Neon Slide 808
presets.desc: A long 808 driven hard enough that its upper harmonics carry the note on small speakers: it drops a few semitones into pitch on every hit and rings for two beats. Bend range is set to an octave for slides.

presets.name: Bounce Saw Bass
presets.desc: Saw plus sub through a snappy ladder filter: a round, plucky synth bass that bounces on the dembow when the 808 is too long.

presets.name: Halo Trance Lead
presets.desc: A singing trance lead: five saws, bright but not harsh, with vibrato that arrives after a third of a second. For hooks over the drop, doubled an octave up for the anthem moment.

presets.name: Y2K Shimmer Arp
presets.desc: A short, glittering saw blip with a fast filter flick: made for 1/16 arpeggios with the dotted-eighth echo, the classic Y2K trance sparkle.

presets.name: Ay Vowel Chop
presets.desc: A synthetic sung 'ay' sped up like tape, bright and short: play it as a melodic vocal chop between the vocal lines.

presets.name: Pixel Pop Pluck
presets.desc: A rubbery, metallic FM pluck that snaps bright and dies fast: the hyperpop counter-melody over a dembow.
